title: Beacon Sweep
summary: Line work, the old kind. Four road beacons between Saltmouth and the Glassroad have gone dark since the last wind, and a dark beacon is how good riders end up in a bad canyon. Ride the sweep, hold station, re-light each one. Pays like charity. Counts like church.

objectives.label: Hold station — re-light beacon one at the east gate
Hold station — re-light beacon two on the dune line
Hold station — re-light beacon three at the south gate
Hold station — re-light beacon four on the Slick Mile
Return the charge caddy to Ketch

offer.text: Four beacons dark between here and the South Gate. Wind got inside the housings again. Before the Driftline had boards and banners, kid, it had this: somebody rides out, stands still in the middle of nowhere, and puts the lights back on for strangers.
Pays nothing worth the word. But every line you'll ever ride was lit by somebody who took this job, so take it.

accept.text: Charge caddy's behind the seat. At each beacon, slow right down and hold station while it draws — the coil needs three honest seconds, no faster than prayer. Then bring the caddy home. Even the sweep has paperwork.
Standing still in the middle of the desert. Finally, a mission that matches my braking habits.

complete.text: Four lights burning on the east road. Some hauler you'll never meet gets home tonight because of that, and they'll never know your name. That's the whole job description, kid — the letters between the words.
Told you. Pays like charity, counts like church. The line remembers, even when the ledger doesn't.
